part.text:
All tests pass. The implementation in `hexadecimal.go`:

- **`ParseHex(in string) (int64, error)`** — converts hex to decimal by hand (no `strconv` or other parsing libraries, per the spec). It rejects empty strings and non-hex digits with a "syntax error", and detects overflow before it happens (`out > (MaxInt64 - digit) / 16`) to return a "range error" instead of wrapping around.
- **`HandleErrors([]string) []string`** — calls `ParseHex` on each input and maps the result to `"none"`, `"syntax"`, or `"range"` using `errors.Is` against two sentinel errors (`errSyntax`, `errRange`) that the wrapped errors carry.

The old stub signature (`ParseHex(in string, out int64, errCase string)`) didn't match what the tests require, so I replaced it with the signatures the test file documents. No new files were created and `hexadecimal_test.go` is untouched.
